title: Review P1
summary: Independent read-only review of P1 against the phase contract and exit criterion produces a verdict file: GREEN, or RED with concrete findings per item.
why: Owner requested a dedicated review at the end of P1 (brief M13). P1 creates the evidence every later phase is measured against: populated persistence fixtures on four drivers, frozen public formats and blocking CI gates — an error here silently weakens P2–P4.

include: P1.1–P1.5 deliverables against P1 contract.produces, boundaries and pitfalls
Baseline integrity: fixtures and snapshots generated from the unchanged 0.7.0 tree; no change under packages/
Allowlists: every entry real, owned, with the correct owner phase; no invariant silently weakened
Unsupported ledger and I7 allowlist: no disagreement recorded as agreement
Invariant register agrees with knowledge/architecture#invariants; exit criterion P1#exit holds
Consumer gate: no path where exit 3 becomes green; release.yml cannot skip it
exclude: Editing code, fixtures or the plan (read-only)
Recursive re-review; a RED verdict returns to the owning item once

reads.why: Register and per-invariant status to verify
Scenarios and frozen formats the fixtures must cover
Identity rows the snapshots must cover

rules: Read-only: the only written file is the verdict.
Each finding names item, file:line or fixture, the violated contract line, severity and the minimal correction.
Run the acceptance commands rather than trusting item results; report a skipped or unavailable check as not green.
guidance: Verdict file format: header (commit reviewed, reviewer route, date), a line `Verdict: GREEN` or `Verdict: RED`, a table of findings (id, item, location, contract clause, severity, correction), and the list of commands run with their outcome.

validation.cmd: composer test:pgsql && composer test:mysql && composer test:mariadb
validation.expect: exit 0 (driver services up: docker compose up -d postgres mysql mariadb)

validation.cmd: composer test:engines:pgsql && composer test:engines:mysql && composer test:engines:mariadb

validation.expect: exit 0 (redis service up; replica fixture starts its own services)

deliverables: artifacts/reviews/P1-review.md with verdict GREEN or RED and findings
